Nora Patel: Heads-up: customer X reports quota billed to partner-proxy instead of their project. Traced it to proxy doing token exchange and not preserving origin metadata.
Marco Li: Quick proposal: proxies emit a short JWT assertion in X-Origin-Assertion (claims: proj, aud=gateway, iat, exp, nonce) signed with proxy key + kid. Gateway verifies via truststore JWKS and uses asserted proj for attribution only if proxy is allowlisted for that proj.
Sam B.: +1. Need per-route canary toggle in console and audit events when assertion accepted. Also add metric "assertion_status" (accepted|rejected|missing).
Julia Chen: Telemetry will add attribution_method label and a card showing token_claim vs assertion attribution. Alert if rejected_assertions > 2% during canary. We'll sample traces for rejections.
audit-bot: audit event recorded: origin_assertion.accepted project=proj_123 proxy=partner-x
Nora Patel: Action items: Marco -> gateway verify + jwks cache; Julia -> dashboard + alert; Sam -> console toggle UI + docs; Nora -> rollout plan. Revisit after staging run. :thumbsup:
